page.overview:
Who is Chef Bear?

Chef Bear resides in a house located in the southeastern corner of Animal Village. She can be found cooking and talking about opening a branch in Mabe Village. She is very amiable to Link and offers him advice on how he can get past the Walrus that blocks Yarna Desert. She is very fond of Marin, and like other residents she refers to her as "Little Marin".

She is also essential for completing the , She asks Link to give her the Honeycomb he obtained from Tarin. In exchange, she gives Link a Pineapple. She believes Honeycombs to be a rare delicacy.
